name: exercise
text: A person performs three jumping jacks as a simple exercise routine. Jump both feet apart while swinging both arms out sideways and up overhead, then jump the feet together while bringing both arms down to the sides. Repeat the full opening and closing motion rhythmically, facing forward in the same spot.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 开合跳片段：双脚开合配合双臂侧上举及放下。试片取36至89帧完整周期重生成，再选中段循环；双手上举接近，不宣称掌心拍合。
